verdict.rationale: Grok Bot is an AI agent that works on your data inside its own apps. The docs describe Team Bots answering metrics questions from a data warehouse, investigating dashboards, traces and flamegraphs to identify the highest-confidence hotspot, and running a scheduled daily customer-risk skill against an account list. It also handles CSV/JSON files and Jupyter notebooks. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how insights and suggestions are generated or presented (only use-case snippets), proactive or unprompted suggestions, and independent hands-on corroboration of data-insight quality.
